pick.name: Canva Free
pick.what: Template-driven design for one-pagers, case studies, decks
pick.why: 1.6M+ templates, PDF export, commercial use allowed per Canva licence (per secondary source); Claude writes the copy
pick.free_limits: Free: templates, 5 GB, 1 brand kit (3 colours), ~20 AI uses/mo; Pro ~USD 144/yr or ~Rs 4,000/yr

alts.name: Claude document skills (pptx/docx/pdf)
alts.why: Already paid (Max); best for data-heavy case studies and proposals generated from CRM notes

candidates.name: Claude document skills
candidates.verdict: Use for text-heavy docs and fast drafts

candidates.name: Gamma
candidates.verdict: AI decks; free 400 one-time credits, watermark (secondary; site blocked fetch)

decision: Claude drafts the copy (one-pager, case study using problem / solution / numbers / quote, security overview), and Canva templates make it look professional. Use Claude's pptx skill when a buyer wants an editable deck.
details: Canva's official licence page blocked fetch (403); commercial-use statement is secondary (unverified).

verify.note: Source is a third-party blog (krea.ai), and Canva's licence page is 403. Commercial use on Canva Free is widely allowed but stays unverified here. Low stakes.
